build_xcit_train_script: build an XCiT model training script with configurable optimizer, scheduler, and augmentation parameters
create_args_parser: create an argparse parser for XCiT training and evaluation with model, dataset, and distributed training options
run_xcit_training: run XCiT model training on ImageNet with cosine LR schedule, mixup, cutmix, and model EMA
test_xcit_evaluation: test XCiT model evaluation on validation dataset and report top-1 accuracy
refactor_xcit_distillation: refactor XCiT training to support knowledge distillation with soft or hard teacher model
